name: Zenithal-Lament
description: A killed landscape, vacuum-scoured and silent. The regolith holds bootprints beautifully; there are some near an orbital debris ring that no expedition has ever claimed.
With no air to speak of, silence is total, broken only by whatever touches your boots. The horizon stays razor-sharp at any distance.
Whoever abandoned the monolithic structures of unknown origin did so in order: power first, then data, then people. The airlocks were cycled from the inside, gently, one last time.
For traders, uranium, iron, platinum and silicon alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
